Quality and Innovation

[Discover our Products][38]

[aoc_logo_white+tagline.png]

 

AOC is the leading global supplier of specialty formulations and solutions which enable customers to
create robust, durable, and versatile products and components for applications in Coatings and
Protective Barriers, Colorants and Visual Effects, Adhesives and Specialties, and conventional
Composites. With strong capabilities worldwide in manufacturing and science, the company works
closely with customers to deliver unrivaled quality, service, and reliability for today and create
innovative solutions for tomorrow. Partner with AOC, and we will work together to find the right
solutions for your business.

Innovation That Helps Our Clients Stand Out in the Market
Innovation That Brings Conventional Competition to the Fresh Air
Innovation That Continuously Improves Business Status Quo

****We believe in continuously adding value through innovation. We empower our clients to adapt to a
quickly changing market environment. We also believe that innovation can help us built a better
future – together.****

****After years of R&D with help of a global tier 1 industry leader, we are now able to provide
affordable and top-quality 2ⁿᵈ generation fiberglass window frame profiles to the European market,
which with the best performance across existing window frame material originating from the high-end
industry.****

**We apply widely acknowledge Innovation Product Development Framework to ensure the End 2 End
product quality and Business Advancement **

**Charter **➔ **R&D Phases **➔ **Test **➔ **Trail **➔ **General Available**

## **Wind Turbine Solutions **

[image7]
Industrial Specified Electrical Insulation Solutions

**We continue serving our clients and help them generate clean energy for the world, and we keep
innovating the solution we offering to reach the evolving technology requirement.**

**The solution we provide serving 6 European countries and acting as a key electrical insulation
package for wind turbine generator.**

**More than 300 wind turbines built annually with our systematically tested and commercially applied
structural reinforced electrical insulation solutions.**

## **Home Insulation and Safety Solutions **

[image5]
Fiber Glass Home Profiles

**After years of R&D with help of a global tier 1 industry leader, we able to provide top quality
and affordable 2ⁿᵈ generation fiberglass window frame profile to the European market, 2ⁿᵈ gen
material is purposely developed for window frame profile applications, the best performance material
with enhanced features originating from the high-end industries.**

**The 2ⁿᵈ Gen fiberglass window frame profile has exclusive advantages for the European market with
the comprehensively best performance across exiting materials.**

**And we are looking into the further requirement to combine the door frame profiles, smart
ventilation, and doorsteps with our innovation capabilities**

## Anti-Corrosion Infrastructures

[image6]
2ⁿᵈ Gen Fiber Glass Bridge System

**Rain, sunshine, snow, storm, salty coastline, temperature variation, the infrastructure get
corrosion quickly under the test of mother nature. We need to keep our infrastructures functioning
with regular check and operation expense (OPEX), to keep them safe.**

**The fiberglass bridge system is our answer because of the nature of our innovation we would like
to offer products one step better with 2ⁿᵈ generation profile material, however, the journey is way
more challenging than we expected, we are close to our product availability under trial production
stage.**

**We only able to show the 3D drawing of the system at this moment, let’s looking forward to the
general available product in the coming future**

AMBC B.V

## **Wind Turbine Solutions **

[image7]
Industrial Specified Electrical Insulation Solutions

**We continue serving our clients and help them generate clean energy for the world, and we keep
innovating the solution we offering to reach the evolving technology requirement.**

**The solution we provide serving 6 European countries and acting as a key electrical insulation
package for wind turbine generator.**

**More than 300 wind turbines built annually with our systematically tested and commercially applied
structural reinforced electrical insulation solutions.**

## **Home Insulation and Safety Solutions **

[image5]
Fiber Glass Home Profiles

**After years of R&D with help of a global tier 1 industry leader, we able to provide top quality
and affordable 2ⁿᵈ generation fiberglass window frame profile to the European market, 2ⁿᵈ gen
material is purposely developed for window frame profile applications, the best performance material
with enhanced features originating from the high-end industries.**

**The 2ⁿᵈ Gen fiberglass window frame profile has exclusive advantages for the European market with
the comprehensively best performance across exiting materials.**

**And we are looking into the further requirement to combine the door frame profiles, smart
ventilation, and doorsteps with our innovation capabilities**

## Anti-Corrosion Infrastructures

[image6]
2ⁿᵈ Gen Fiber Glass Bridge System

**Rain, sunshine, snow, storm, salty coastline, temperature variation, the infrastructure get
corrosion quickly under the test of mother nature. We need to keep our infrastructures functioning
with regular check and operation expense (OPEX), to keep them safe.**

to offer products one step better with 2ⁿᵈ generation profile material, however, the journey is way
more challenging than we expected, we are close to our product availability under trial production

general available product in the coming future**

# Welcome to Ashirvad Industries

Ashirvad Industries is the manufacturer, exporters & supplier of special purpose machinery for
Composite Industry, Pultrusion Machine, Pultrusion Equipment, Pultrusion Machinery, SMC Machine
(sheet molding compound machine), Polymer Insulator Epoxy Rod Pultrusion, Epoxy Pultrusion Rod for
Polymer Insulator, Polymer Insulator Plant Equipment and other equipment’s for composites industry.

Ashirvad Industries is a leading India based Pultrusion Machine’s, SMC Machine (Sheet Moulding
Compounds Machine), Pultrusion Dies, Pultrusion Mould, Pultrusion Tooling manufacturer and has been
serving the various domestic and international industries by exporting / supplying world class
F.R.P. Pultrusions Machines and G.R.P. Pultrusions Machines, which are using these days worldwide in
various industries to manufacture different FRP pultrusion products and GRP pultrusion products,
which can be used for industrial and recreational uses.

*The company is devoted to the design, manufacture, assembly, finish and maintenance of industrial
plants for assured performance.*

*We have contributed to all leading composite product manufacturers located in all parts of India as
well as export market,*

*We are constantly improving our products from every aspect of engineering excellence and productive
performance. *

*Because of our highly reliable and technically expert staff, our organization is eager to fit any
of our machines to the volume and sizes required by our customers. *

*Our service starts with a previous need analysis, always trying to advice our clients and making

*Also we have produced customized application machinery.*

*Ashirvad Industries manufacturers advanced Pultrusion Machines with precision, durability, and

Welcome to ATLAS COMPOSITES PRIVATE LIMITED

## FRP PULTRUSION PRODUCTS & COMPONENTS With Experience

ATLAS COMPOSITES PRIVATE LIMITED offer a wide of pultrusion products from pultrusion process.
Pultrusion is a continuous composite fabrication process where continuous reinforcing fibres are
impregnated with thermosetting matrix and are pulled through a heated die to form composite
profiles. It has the capabilities to run continuously with constant cross section profile with the
mass production volume.
* Structural Shapes
* Electrical Insulation Rods
* Consumer Product Range
* Cost-effective properties
* Corrosion Resistant
* High-strength & durability
* Non-Conductive
* Electromagnetic Transparency

[About Us][11]
[ Download Brochure ][12]
[img]


## Structural Shapes

Pultrusion Structural Shapes are good alternative over conservative metal structural shapes & Offers
ideal solution against corrosion problems failed in industrial environment.

Use

Walkways, platforms, columns, trusses, structural supports. Cable trays are used for housing
electrical cables within buildings and cable ladders are used for transporting cables within roof
and wall structures.

[img]


## Electrical Insulation Rod and Tubes

Many types of pultrusion Rod, Flats, Angles & end pieces offers very goods electrical insulation
property in combination with high mechanical strength corrosion resistance & all climate resistance
for inside & Outside applications. These Variation of pultrusion products are available with
polyester, Vinyl ester & Epoxy Resins.

Use

Bus bar support, Dry type Transporter Spacers, 11KV/33KV Cross Arms & other Electrical insulation
Requirements.

[img]


## FRP Antenna Radome

A fiberglass reinforced plastic radome is fiberglass material made of resin and glass fiber
composited in a certain proportion, and an antenna case made by various molding processes.

Use

Fiberglass antenna/radome cover is light weight, excellent in wave penetration various in shape and
specification, and suitable for various harsh environments. It has been widely used in aerospace
communication, metrology and other fields.

[img]


## Consumer Product Range

ATLAS Composites Private Limited has development wide range of pultruded products to offer
attractive solution in industrial & in Commercial & Consumer Product Range.

Use

Door Frames, Storage Racks, Window Lineals, etc.

[img]


## Pultruded Gratings

Pultrusion Gratings are manufactured by assemble of pultrusion I-Beam & pultrusion cross rods. The
distance between I-Beam & Cross rods depend upon various load conditions, Pultrusion Gratings offers
advanced solution against critical problem of corrosion in industrial environment.

Use

Chemical Plants, Refineries, Power Plants, Marine & offshore Fittings, Effluent Treatment Plants.

## Captrad - Manufacturing, Stocking and Delivering GRP Products

## A Little About Captrad...

Captrad Ltd was established in 1999 based in Wigan the North West of England.

Originally only producing Moulded GRP products we soon realised that projects and customers required
more than just this from a supplier. As a result, we now supply a wide range of GRP Products from
our dedicated facility in Skelmersdale and are able to offer next day deliveries on all stocked GRP
products. Whether that’s [GRP Structural Profiles][65], [GRP Gratings][66], [GRP Handrails][67] or
[GRP Cable trays][68] we can ship pretty much anywhere in the UK next day. Other products such as
[GRP Cabinets][69] and [Enclosures][70] may take a little longer and we can offer bespoke services
on the majority of our GRP Products. Whatever your GRP/ Composite project is Captrad can offer a
full service from design advice to creating the full solution and delivering in a timely manner.
Please call today with your project requirements to discuss with one of our sales team – [01695
280510][71]

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

this crisis. By launching a Composite material production line, you supply the market with a
corrosion-free alternative that builders urgently need, securing your place in a high-growth sector.

steel manufacturing in efficiency. While GFRP rebar offers 2.5–3x higher tensile strength, our
Advanced FRP equipment ensures you produce it at lowest cost. Our Glass fiber reinforced plastic
production line minimizes waste (<5%) and maximizes output, enabling you to capitalize on the
explosive demand for High quality GFRP products.

  our Glass fiber reinforced plastic production line runs with minimal staffing and waste (<5%),

  shifts to corrosion-free materials, your Composite building material production plant will be

CQFD Composites delivers *high performance pultruded thermoplastic composites* for high-end
applications in the form of linear profiles,[ curved profiles][34], semi products or structural
inserts with extremely high content of reinforcing fibres which can generate strategic advantages in
Construction, Transport, or Electrical applications.

plastic specialists followed Akaki to China. Of course, they bring their rich fiber glass experience

experts, more than 400 skilled workers, and many cooperative partners. DOFRP specializes in the
research, development, and design of FRP composite products. The fiberglass reinforced plastic FRP
has much high performance. It is corrosion resistant, thermally insulated, has the lightweight, and
good electrical insulation. Fiberglass products we produced with good cost effectiveness have been
widely applied to many fields. For example, aerospace, architecture, automotive, infrastructure,
marine, pipe and tank, transportation, and so on. They have a wide variety. FRP custom products
include molded fiberglass, [FRP panels][57], FRP wall paneling, fiberglass pipes, fiberglass car
bodies, fiberglass radome, auto parts, medical parts, etc.

#### [
#### FRP manufacturing process
#### ][58]

DOFRP combines the professional knowledge and experience in FRP science, manufacturing process, and
technology with a deep understanding of our clients’ needs. Manufacturing processes which fiberglass
manufacturers mainly adopt include hand layup process, filament winding process, pultrusion process,
and compression molding process. The former two manufacturing processes are in an open mold. And the
latter two are in a closed mold.

#### [
#### Composite Layup Process
#### ][59]

First of all, the FRP molding for hand layup is not limited by the dimension and complex shapes of
the fiberglass products. And FRP manufacturers only need to pay simple equipment and less investment
but have a quick effect.

#### [
#### Filament Winding Process
#### ][60]

Another, the filament winding is wrapping the continuous glass fiber impregnated with polyester
resins around the mold core. The core material we often use includes balsa, honeycomb, foam, and
aluminum. After the coring and mold release, you can get the final product.

#### [
#### Pultrusion Process
#### ][61]

Under the traction of the traction equipment, fiberglass manufacturers use the polyester resins to
soak the fiber glass, heat it with forming mold to solidify the fiberglass and resin. And this kind
of process which FRP manufacturers use to produce composite profiles is the pultrusion. It has a
high use rate of raw materials, high production efficiency, and can be used to produce complex
structural FRP profiles.

#### [
#### Compression Molding Process
#### ][62]

Last, compression molding we adopt for fiberglass reinforced plastic FRP can be used to produce high
quality fiberglass products. And the mold laminating is cutting the glass fibers or other fabrics
which have presoaked with resin glue to the desired shape. Then heating or pressing the composite
material to the final product in the metal mold. Fiberglass laminating has a small loss of raw
materials, high precision of product size, and mass production with molding equipment. Thus, it has
high performance of relatively low production cost.

## Specialists In FRP Field

DOFRP is a Sino-Japanese joint venture since 1991. The first batch of Japanese fiberglass reinforced
plastic specialists followed Akaki to China. Of course, they bring their rich fiber glass experience
to China, help establish and develop the fiberglass company. Until now, we have 19 Japanese FRP
experts, more than 400 skilled workers, and many cooperative partners. DOFRP specializes in the
research, development, and design of FRP composite products. The fiberglass reinforced plastic FRP
has much high performance. It is corrosion resistant, thermally insulated, has the lightweight, and
good electrical insulation. Fiberglass products we produced with good cost effectiveness have been
widely applied to many fields. For example, aerospace, architecture, automotive, infrastructure,
marine, pipe and tank, transportation, and so on. They have a wide variety. FRP custom products
include molded fiberglass, [FRP panels][57], FRP wall paneling, fiberglass pipes, fiberglass car
bodies, fiberglass radome, auto parts, medical parts, etc.

#### [
#### FRP manufacturing process
#### ][58]

DOFRP combines the professional knowledge and experience in FRP science, manufacturing process, and
technology with a deep understanding of our clients’ needs. Manufacturing processes which fiberglass
manufacturers mainly adopt include hand layup process, filament winding process, pultrusion process,
and compression molding process. The former two manufacturing processes are in an open mold. And the
latter two are in a closed mold.

#### [
#### Composite Layup Process
#### ][59]

First of all, the FRP molding for hand layup is not limited by the dimension and complex shapes of
the fiberglass products. And FRP manufacturers only need to pay simple equipment and less investment
but have a quick effect.

#### [
#### Filament Winding Process
#### ][60]

Another, the filament winding is wrapping the continuous glass fiber impregnated with polyester
resins around the mold core. The core material we often use includes balsa, honeycomb, foam, and
aluminum. After the coring and mold release, you can get the final product.

#### [
#### Pultrusion Process
#### ][61]

Under the traction of the traction equipment, fiberglass manufacturers use the polyester resins to
soak the fiber glass, heat it with forming mold to solidify the fiberglass and resin. And this kind
of process which FRP manufacturers use to produce composite profiles is the pultrusion. It has a
high use rate of raw materials, high production efficiency, and can be used to produce complex
structural FRP profiles.

#### [
#### Compression Molding Process
#### ][62]

Last, compression molding we adopt for fiberglass reinforced plastic FRP can be used to produce high
quality fiberglass products. And the mold laminating is cutting the glass fibers or other fabrics
which have presoaked with resin glue to the desired shape. Then heating or pressing the composite
material to the final product in the metal mold. Fiberglass laminating has a small loss of raw
materials, high precision of product size, and mass production with molding equipment. Thus, it has
high performance of relatively low production cost.

## Hand lay up

For large components, such as boat hulls, fiberglass auto parts and fiberglass radome.
[[hand-lay-up-frp]][63]

## Filament winding

For pressure vessels, storage tanks, golf club shafts, fishing rods and fiberglass pipes.

[[Filament-winding-frp]][64]

## Pultrusion process

For molded fiberglass, hollow tubes, ceiling tiles, fiberglass bars, angles and channels.

[[pultrusion-frp]][65]

## Compression mold

For structural automotive components, such as fiberglass bumpers and hoods.

[[Compression-molding]][66]

## What are composites?

Composites, also known as fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP), are materials composed of reinforcements
(fibers) and a matrix (resin).

Often chosen for their low weight, corrosion resistance, durability and aesthetic quality,
composites can be designed for purpose to allow you more flexibility .

At Exel, we specialize in the continuous manufacturing methods of pultrusion and
pull-winding that efficiently and consistently produce high-performance, high quality solutions.

## What are composites?

Composites, also known as fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP), are materials composed of reinforcements
(fibers) and a matrix (resin).

Often chosen for their low weight, corrosion resistance, durability and aesthetic quality,
composites can be designed for purpose to allow you more flexibility .

At Exel, we specialize in the continuous manufacturing methods of pultrusion and
pull-winding that efficiently and consistently produce high-performance, high quality solutions.

Fibre-reinforced profiles and technical winding components

## GFR ProfileS – CFRP ProfileS – PULTRUDED PROFILES

**Ernst Kühne Kunststoffwerk manufactures fibre-reinforced plastic profiles using the pultrusion and
filament winding techniques.**

Our pultruded profiles are reinforced using glass fibre, carbon fibre, aramid fibre or basalt fibre.
They are impregnated with epoxy, vinylester, polyester and acrylic resins, and then gradually cured
using a heated die.

We can provide a wide range of pultruded profiles as standard, including round profiles,
semi-circular profiles, rectangular profiles, hollow profiles and more (see our [Profile
Catalog][64] for full details). We are also experts in manufacturing complex, one-off shapes.

We can produce pultruded profiles of any length, as well as supplying weather-resistant profiles,
profiles with conductive surfaces, and flame-retardant profiles. We can also deliver profiles in
custom colours to suit your needs. Pultruded profiles are used in all industrial settings, including
in the automotive, aerospace and defence sectors, in rail vehicles, and in wind turbines.

# TECHNOLOGY

## PULTRUDED PROFILES

### WACOSIT® pultruded profiles

Construction and characteristics **WACOSIT®** profiles are made using a process known as
“**pultrusion**.” The fibres used to reinforce the profile are injected with artificial resin and
then gradually cured in a heated mould.

**WACOSIT®** profiles can be reinforced with glass fibre, carbon fibre, aramid fibre and basalt
fibre. There are various different specifications for each of these different types of fibre. The
most commonly used glass fibres are E-glass fibres, but profiles can also be made with R, S, or
T-glass fibres, which come with enhanced mechanical properties.

The resin matrix includes epoxy, vinylester, polyester and acrylic resin.

# Who we are

## Ernst Kühne – Innovation from the start

**“Ernst Kühne revolutionised the manufacturing process for fibre-reinforced plastics when he
developed the pultrusion technique.**

In early 1954, Ernst Kühne invented the pultrusion process while working in a major electrical
manufacturer’s development lab. Kühne produced his first extruded products, featuring glass rovings
and impregnated with epoxy resin, himself. As well as the pultrusion technique, Ernst Kühne also
invented the machinery required for the process, as well as made-to-measure dies. It was at this
early stage that the electrical, chemical and mechanical parameters associated with pultrusion
profiles were first determined. Kühne then went on to set up Ernst Kühne Kunststoffwerk; Europe’s
first pultrusion manufacturer.

Around the same time, W.P. Goldworthy, one of the pioneers of fibre composite technology, was
introducing the pultrusion process in the United States. However, his work concentrated on
manufacturing profiles using polyester resin, whereas Ernst Kühne focused primarily on epoxy
resin.”  – *Cit. Wikipedia*

[ Find out more + ][92]

# Support

## WACOSIT®-Profiles: Structure and properties

**We use polyester, vinylester and epoxy resins to make our WACOSIT® profiles.**

In order to conduct computational analysis of fibre composite materials, you need to know the
elasticity and modulus of rigidity for the unidirectional single layer. Unidirectional construction
leads to greater rigidity and stiffness in the direction of the fibres than can be achieved with a
shear or transfer layout.

Fibre-reinforced profiles and technical winding components

## GFR ProfileS – CFRP ProfileS – PULTRUDED PROFILES

**Ernst Kühne Kunststoffwerk manufactures fibre-reinforced plastic profiles using the pultrusion and
filament winding techniques.**

Our pultruded profiles are reinforced using glass fibre, carbon fibre, aramid fibre or basalt fibre.
They are impregnated with epoxy, vinylester, polyester and acrylic resins, and then gradually cured
using a heated die.

We can provide a wide range of pultruded profiles as standard, including round profiles,
semi-circular profiles, rectangular profiles, hollow profiles and more (see our [Profile
Catalog][64] for full details). We are also experts in manufacturing complex, one-off shapes.

We can produce pultruded profiles of any length, as well as supplying weather-resistant profiles,
profiles with conductive surfaces, and flame-retardant profiles. We can also deliver profiles in
custom colours to suit your needs. Pultruded profiles are used in all industrial settings, including
in the automotive, aerospace and defence sectors, in rail vehicles, and in wind turbines.

# TECHNOLOGY

## PULTRUDED PROFILES

### WACOSIT® pultruded profiles

Construction and characteristics **WACOSIT®** profiles are made using a process known as
“**pultrusion**.” The fibres used to reinforce the profile are injected with artificial resin and
then gradually cured in a heated mould.

**WACOSIT®** profiles can be reinforced with glass fibre, carbon fibre, aramid fibre and basalt
fibre. There are various different specifications for each of these different types of fibre. The
most commonly used glass fibres are E-glass fibres, but profiles can also be made with R, S, or
T-glass fibres, which come with enhanced mechanical properties.

The resin matrix includes epoxy, vinylester, polyester and acrylic resin.

# Who we are

## Ernst Kühne – Innovation from the start

**“Ernst Kühne revolutionised the manufacturing process for fibre-reinforced plastics when he
developed the pultrusion technique.**

In early 1954, Ernst Kühne invented the pultrusion process while working in a major electrical
manufacturer’s development lab. Kühne produced his first extruded products, featuring glass rovings
and impregnated with epoxy resin, himself. As well as the pultrusion technique, Ernst Kühne also
invented the machinery required for the process, as well as made-to-measure dies. It was at this
early stage that the electrical, chemical and mechanical parameters associated with pultrusion
profiles were first determined. Kühne then went on to set up Ernst Kühne Kunststoffwerk; Europe’s
first pultrusion manufacturer.

Around the same time, W.P. Goldworthy, one of the pioneers of fibre composite technology, was
introducing the pultrusion process in the United States. However, his work concentrated on
manufacturing profiles using polyester resin, whereas Ernst Kühne focused primarily on epoxy
resin.”  – *Cit. Wikipedia*

# Support

## WACOSIT®-Profiles: Structure and properties

**We use polyester, vinylester and epoxy resins to make our WACOSIT® profiles.**

In order to conduct computational analysis of fibre composite materials, you need to know the
elasticity and modulus of rigidity for the unidirectional single layer. Unidirectional construction
leads to greater rigidity and stiffness in the direction of the fibres than can be achieved with a
shear or transfer layout.

About Us

## Co-rotating Twin-screw Extruders

### Together, We Develop Your New Compounding Line

FEDDEM is your expert partner for the development, design and construction of extrusion and
compounding lines in plastic industries. With over 30 years of experience, we offer you everything
from standardised products to completely customised solutions for your needs. The worldwide project
planning and delivery of turnkey compounding plants including peripheral equipment as well as a
flexible spare-parts and repair service round off our comprehensive portfolio.

We act on your behalf, maintain personal contacts, listen to you and ensure that we fully understand
your needs and requirements. We are a reliable team of mechanical engineering enthusiasts who want
to provide you with a technical plastics solution that fits exactly.

## Extrusion Lines for Top Performance

Powerful Extrusion, Elegant Process.

All-round service in all areas.

Learn more

## Certified quality management

Outstanding quality, satisfied customers, sustainability and the safety of our employees are
obligatory for us. In all these areas, we strive to achieve a high standard – and thus secure the
long-term success of our company. Certification to ISO 9001:2015 is part of a comprehensive
integrated management system called FEDDEM Excellence. This has been established since 2012 and is
legally binding with regard to our commitment to quality and improvement.

## Co-rotating Twin-screw Extruders

### Together, We Develop Your New Compounding Line

FEDDEM is your expert partner for the development, design and construction of extrusion and
compounding lines in plastic industries. With over 30 years of experience, we offer you everything
from standardised products to completely customised solutions for your needs. The worldwide project
planning and delivery of turnkey compounding plants including peripheral equipment as well as a
flexible spare-parts and repair service round off our comprehensive portfolio.

We act on your behalf, maintain personal contacts, listen to you and ensure that we fully understand
your needs and requirements. We are a reliable team of mechanical engineering enthusiasts who want
to provide you with a technical plastics solution that fits exactly.

integrated management system called FEDDEM Excellence. This has been established since 2012 and is
legally binding with regard to our commitment to quality and improvement.

Why Choose **fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP)** instead of steel?

Contractors and architects prefer FRP over metal, wood and concrete for many industrial and
construction applications. The benefits of building with FRP:
* FRP is **70% lighter** than steel with an exceptional strength-to-weight ratio.
* FRP is corrosion resistant and requires **less maintenance** than traditional metal, wood and
  concrete products.
* FRP is non-conductive and slip resistant, providing a **safer alternative** to steel and concrete.
* We manufacture and fabricate FRP in a range of colors and shapes, giving architects options for
  creating **compelling structures.**
*

## Flowserve Officially Acquires Trillium Flow Technologies’ Valves Division  

Delivering a broader portfolio of engineered valve technologies, extensive nuclear valve solutions,
and high‑quality OEM lifecycle services for the world’s most demanding, high‑consequence
applications.

## Turbomachinery Lifecycle Expertise Now Part of Flowserve Services  

Flowserve has expanded our services portfolio through the acquisitions of Greenray and Allen Steam
Turbines™ to strengthen support for aging and legacy gas and steam turbine fleets. 

[Learn more][164]

## Introducing the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal for High‑Value Mixer Applications  

Flowserve has launched the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal — a carbon‑free, dry‑running sealing solution
engineered specifically for demanding top‑entry mixers. Designed to help reduce contamination risk
at its source, LMX delivers reliable performance when purity, precision and product integrity are on
the line.

[Learn more][165]

## Powering the Future of LNG Regasification  

Developed from decades of LNG expertise, the Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump – High Pressure (HP)
Series combines advanced cryogenic pumping technology with efficiency, reliability, and
serviceability to help operators lower costs and improve long-term performance.

[Learn more][166]

## Komu dodáváme výrobní technologie

### Výrobci FRP/GRP kompozitů

Pultruzní stroje pro kontinuální výrobu profilů, tyčí, trubek a plochých lamel. Míchačky pro
homogenizaci pryskyřic.

### Letecký a obranný průmysl

Pultruzní linky pro karbonová vlákna a vysokopevnostní lamely. Přesné servoelektrické řízení pro
náročné tolerance.

### Stavební průmysl a infrastruktura

Linky pro výrobu FRP výztuže do betonu a konstrukčních profilů. Korozivzdorná alternativa k oceli.

### Výzkumné organizace a startupy

Laboratorní a poloprovozní stroje pro vývoj materiálů a technologií. Škálování od vzorků po
produkci.

## Proč Foller

### 30 let zkušeností s vývojem a výrobou kompozitních strojů

Nejsme distributor ani integrátor — vyrábíme vlastní stroje od roku 1998. Konstruktér je dostupný
přímo.

### Kompletní řešení pro váš výrobní proces

Od míchání pryskyřice přes pultruzní linku po hotový profil. Jeden dodavatel, konzistentní know-how.

### Vlastní R&D a laboratorní zázemí

Testujeme materiály (DSC, TGA, DMA), vyvíjíme nové technologie a přizpůsobujeme stroje vašemu
procesu.

### Přímá výroba v ČR, rychlý servis

Přímý kontakt s konstruktérem, servis bez zprostředkovatelů, rychlá odezva.

## Časté otázky

S jakými materiály umíte pracovat?

Specializujeme se na dvousložkové epoxidové, polyuretanové a polyesterové pryskyřice včetně plniv,
aditiv a pigmentů. Dále pracujeme s hořlavými lepidly, nátěrovými hmotami a průmyslovými
chemikáliemi. Pokud si nejste jisti, obraťte se na nás — v konzultaci projdeme váš konkrétní
materiál.

Vyrábíte míchačky pro hořlavé / výbušné prostředí?

Ano. Nabízíme provedení s bezjiskřivými elektromotory pro práci s hořlavými a výbušnými směsmi (ATEX
zóny). Vybavení volíme podle třídy nebezpečnosti prostředí a charakteru míšeného materiálu.

Jak dlouho trvá dodání stroje?

Typicky 8–14 týdnů od potvrzení objednávky. Přesný termín závisí na konfiguraci, dostupnosti
komponent (zejména motorů a řídicích jednotek) a aktuální vytíženosti výroby. Přesný harmonogram vám
sdělíme při tvorbě nabídky.

Můžeme vám poslat vzorek našeho materiálu k testování?

Ano, testování na vašem materiálu je součástí procesu. Pokud po prvotní konzultaci dojdeme k závěru,
že spolupráce dává smysl pro obě strany, otestujeme váš materiál na našem zařízení a doladíme
parametry míchacího elementu a otáček.

Poskytujete servis a údržbu?

Ano. Servis zajišťujeme přímo z ČR — bez prostředníků. Při dodání provedeme instalaci a zaškolení
obsluhy. Následný servis a náhradní díly dodáváme průběžně. Přímý kontakt s konstruktérem je
standardem, ne výjimkou.

Jaké objemy zvládnete? Od laboratoře po produkci?

Naše standardní platformy pokrývají rozsah 5–500 litrů. Pro specifické aplikace (menší laboratorní
objemy nebo nadrozměrné produkční nádoby) rádi navrhneme řešení na míru.

Co když potřebujeme nestandardní konfiguraci?

Nestandardní konfigurace jsou naší specialitou. Přizpůsobíme lopatky, délku a průměr hřídele,
materiál ve styku s médiem (nerezová ocel, speciální povlaky), řídicí jednotku i způsob upevnění.
Výroba na míru je naší hlavní přidanou hodnotou.

Můžeme stroj vidět naživo před objednávkou?

Ano. V rámci procesu nabízíme návštěvu našeho výrobního a testovacího zázemí. Domluvíme se na
termínu po úvodní video konzultaci.

Jaká je cenová úroveň?

Cena se odvíjí od konfigurace — objemu, výkonu, typu motoru, ATEX provedení a řídic

## Komu dodáváme výrobní technologie

### Výrobci FRP/GRP kompozitů

Pultruzní stroje pro kontinuální výrobu profilů, tyčí, trubek a plochých lamel. Míchačky pro
homogenizaci pryskyřic.

### Letecký a obranný průmysl

Pultruzní linky pro karbonová vlákna a vysokopevnostní lamely. Přesné servoelektrické řízení pro
náročné tolerance.

### Stavební průmysl a infrastruktura

Linky pro výrobu FRP výztuže do betonu a konstrukčních profilů. Korozivzdorná alternativa k oceli.

### Výzkumné organizace a startupy

Laboratorní a poloprovozní stroje pro vývoj materiálů a technologií. Škálování od vzorků po
produkci.

## Proč Foller

### 30 let zkušeností s vývojem a výrobou kompozitních strojů

Nejsme distributor ani integrátor — vyrábíme vlastní stroje od roku 1998. Konstruktér je dostupný
přímo.

### Kompletní řešení pro váš výrobní proces

Od míchání pryskyřice přes pultruzní linku po hotový profil. Jeden dodavatel, konzistentní know-how.

### Vlastní R&D a laboratorní zázemí

Testujeme materiály (DSC, TGA, DMA), vyvíjíme nové technologie a přizpůsobujeme stroje vašemu
procesu.

### Přímá výroba v ČR, rychlý servis

Přímý kontakt s konstruktérem, servis bez zprostředkovatelů, rychlá odezva.

## Časté otázky

S jakými materiály umíte pracovat?

Specializujeme se na dvousložkové epoxidové, polyuretanové a polyesterové pryskyřice včetně plniv,
aditiv a pigmentů. Dále pracujeme s hořlavými lepidly, nátěrovými hmotami a průmyslovými
chemikáliemi. Pokud si nejste jisti, obraťte se na nás — v konzultaci projdeme váš konkrétní
materiál.

Vyrábíte míchačky pro hořlavé / výbušné prostředí?

Ano. Nabízíme provedení s bezjiskřivými elektromotory pro práci s hořlavými a výbušnými směsmi (ATEX
zóny). Vybavení volíme podle třídy nebezpečnosti prostředí a charakteru míšeného materiálu.

Jak dlouho trvá dodání stroje?

Typicky 8–14 týdnů od potvrzení objednávky. Přesný termín závisí na konfiguraci, dostupnosti
komponent (zejména motorů a řídicích jednotek) a aktuální vytíženosti výroby. Přesný harmonogram vám
sdělíme při tvorbě nabídky.

Můžeme vám poslat vzorek našeho materiálu k testování?

Ano, testování na vašem materiálu je součástí procesu. Pokud po prvotní konzultaci dojdeme k závěru,
že spolupráce dává smysl pro obě strany, otestujeme váš materiál na našem zařízení a doladíme
parametry míchacího elementu a otáček.

Poskytujete servis a údržbu?

Ano. Servis zajišťujeme přímo z ČR — bez prostředníků. Při dodání provedeme instalaci a zaškolení
obsluhy. Následný servis a náhradní díly dodáváme průběžně. Přímý kontakt s konstruktérem je
standardem, ne výjimkou.

Jaké objemy zvládnete? Od laboratoře po produkci?

Naše standardní platformy pokrývají rozsah 5–500 litrů. Pro specifické aplikace (menší laboratorní
objemy nebo nadrozměrné produkční nádoby) rádi navrhneme řešení na míru.

Co když potřebujeme nestandardní konfiguraci?

Nestandardní konfigurace jsou naší specialitou. Přizpůsobíme lopatky, délku a průměr hřídele,
materiál ve styku s médiem (nerezová ocel, speciální povlaky), řídicí jednotku i způsob upevnění.
Výroba na míru je naší hlavní přidanou hodnotou.

Můžeme stroj vidět naživo před objednávkou?

Ano. V rámci procesu nabízíme návštěvu našeho výrobního a testovacího zázemí. Domluvíme se na
termínu po úvodní video konzultaci.

Jaká je cenová úroveň?

Cena se odvíjí od konfigurace — objemu, výkonu, typu motoru, ATEX provedení a řídic

# ABOUT US

### Chongqing Dujiang Composites Co., Ltd.

Chongqing Dujiang Composites Co., Ltd. is a private enterprise integrating industry and trade. that
sells composite materials and derivatives including fiberglass roving, fiberglass mat, fiberglass
mesh, fiberglass fabric, chopped strands, carbon fiber fabric, aramid fiber fabric, the resin,
fiberglass rod, fiberglass rebar, fiberglass tubes, and other FRP profiles. Three generations of the
company have accumulated more than 50 years Of development, adhering to the service tenet of
“Integrity, Innovation, Harmony, and Win-win”, and established a complete one-stop procurement and
comprehensive solution service system. The company has 289 employees and annual sales of 300-700
million yuan.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

## A heritage worth celebrating

Over nearly two centuries, we’ve transformed again and again – but always with a focus on materials.
From textiles to rubber, from dental and health to high-performance composites, our journey has been
one of evolution and ever expanding expertise.

## Materials

Gurit has everything you need to bring your ideas to life, whether it’s a cutting-edge lightweight
design or a cost-effective solution for your composite project. With our extensive portfolio —
including structural cores, prepregs, glass profiles and epoxies — we offer a comprehensive range of
products, engineering expertise, and equipment to meet your needs.

[Discover our Portfolio][96]

From digital optimization and structural engineering to manufacturing solutions and global kitting,
Gurit provides the expertise and services needed to design and build composite structures with
confidence.

sustainability in everything we do, we aim to lead by example—minimizing impact, championing ethics,

Over nearly two centuries, we’ve transformed again and again – but always with a focus on materials.
From textiles to rubber, from dental and health to high-performance composites, our journey has been

Why Choose Hexcel

## Designed for Demanding Composite Applications

Hexcel empowers engineers and manufacturers with high-performance, certification-backed composite
materials. Our solutions are crafted to meet rigorous standards in both performance and delivery.
Preferred Carbon Fiber Developer

Hexcel is the world’s largest producer of aerospace carbon fiber and the leading supplier of carbon
fiber to U.S. military programs, making it an industry leader in advanced aerospace materials.

Honeycomb Manufacturing

Hexcel is the global leader in honeycomb manufacturing developing lightweight core material offering
exceptional light weighting, stiffness, and noise and energy absorption.

Product Safety

We are committed to providing support and customer care to help our customers safely handle and use
our products and enable them to fulfill their legal obligations.

Advanced Process Innovation

At Hexcel, a culture of innovation permeates our organization and is a strategic priority. Targeting
a breakthrough, aiming for what seems an unrealistic goal, or challenging some long-held paradigm
are springboards to discovery and thinking “outside the box.” We embrace the curiosity to explore
ideas, the passion to challenge the impossible and the conviction to succeed beyond expectations.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

Join IntechOpen in its mission to publish the best scientific research and increase the visibility of your work. [Learn More][61] ### Author in the Centre Built by scientists, for scientists. We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. [faq home banner]
What FRP pultruded profiles and services does IncomePultrusion offer?

IncomePultrusion manufactures standard and custom pultruded FRP profiles including rods, tubes,
bars, angles, channels, beams, grating, rebar, fasteners, and sheet piling. We also design and build
pultrusion machinery, dies, and tooling, and provide resin system selection support. Custom
cross-sections are developed from client drawings or samples.

How does IncomePultrusion ensure product quality and consistency?

We follow controlled manufacturing protocols with incoming material inspection, in-process
dimensional monitoring, and final mechanical property testing. Our pultrusion lines use
temperature-controlled curing zones and continuous pull-force monitoring. Quality documentation
including test reports and material certificates is available on request.

What is the typical lead time and minimum order quantity for pultruded profiles?

Standard profiles ship within 2–4 weeks. Custom profiles requiring new tooling typically require 4–6
weeks for tooling plus 2–3 weeks for production. Minimum order quantities start at 500 meters for
standard shapes and 1,000 meters for custom designs. Trial batches are available for qualification
purposes.

What payment terms does IncomePultrusion accept for international orders?

We accept T/T (telegraphic transfer) with 30% deposit and 70% before shipment for initial orders.
Established partners may qualify for net-30 or letter-of-credit terms. All quotations include
Incoterms (typically FOB Shanghai or CIF destination) so pricing is transparent.

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

challenges across various industries that are not easily addressed by current available-in-market

#### About Us

## Overview

Intralink Techno is a world leading manufacturer of Pultruded F/GRP products for the oil & gas,
power, cooling tower & petrochemical segments. Our trademarked brand consists of the INTECH Cable
support system INTECH structure profiles as well as customized products specialized for industrial
or infrastructure solutions, boasts an unparalleled track record across different countries &
industry applications.

[ Read more ][39]

## Our Products

With more than 20 years' experience in the FRP industry, INTECH is now one of the most prominent
globally-recognized composite brand.

Our product includes the trademarked INTECH cable support system. INTECH Structural profiles ,
gratings , caged ladder system and other customized solutions.

## Structural Profile

With more than 100 different profile types from I beam, hollow sections, C channels and other
complex shapes catering to the evolving cooling tower market segment where corrosion and light
weight takes precedence over traditional building material such as Steel & Concrete. All our
products are tested in accordance to the highest qualification of CTI-137 standards

[ Learn more ][40]

## Grating

INTECH grating products are widely used across industries such as offshore, onshore oil & gas.
Tackling weight constraints imposed on offshore platform users, generating overall project savings
through total weight optimization. Our products are 3rd party tested and approved under the ABS
(american bureau of shipping) product type approval class 1

[ Learn more ][41]

## Cable Ladder & Tray

INTECH’s cable ladder & trays are designed to comply and exceed the world recognized NEMA & IEC
standards. The complete system is designed to be anti-corrosive , fire retardant and non conductive.
servicing the growing market segment within oil & gas, power generation, water treatment and
renewable energy industry, where corrosion is a real-life problem for most of these clients.

[ Learn more ][42]

## Caged Ladder System

Our caged ladder system is designed to meet the demanding requirements of various industrial
applications. Engineered from high-strength, corrosion-resistant fiberglass composite materials, it
offers numerous advantages over traditional materials such as steel, aluminum, and wood. These
systems are ideally suited for environments where durability, safety, and minimal maintenance are
critical.

[ Learn more ][43]

## Custom-Made Projects

Intralink Techno provides support to our clients in developing custom engineered profiles aimed at
solving project complications which cannot be resolved with any current available products. With our
in-house experts and dedicated engineers, our team will respond to your problem statement and
provide a custom solution. An in-house testing team will also be assigned to ensure the custom-made
product are fit for application

[ Learn more ][44]

## Our Manufacturing Capabilities

Intralink Techno’s manufacturing facility Is equipped with 20 active pultrusion lines with a
capacity of up to 300km or 400 metric tons of pultruded profiles per month enabling us to support
Mega scale projects

## Conversion to Non-Metallic products

Fibreglass is a sustainable material that offers significant environmental advantages compared to
traditional materials like steel. Its’ lightweight, durability, and resistance to environmental
degradation promising a longer- lifespan. Its’ manufacturing process is energy-efficient, with much
lower carbon emission than steel. contributing to reduced carbon footprint. Ongoing innovations in
production and recycling are enhancing its sustainability, making FRP an increasingly viable choice
for various applications and supporting efforts to reduce environmental impact.

#### About Us

## Overview

Intralink Techno is a world leading manufacturer of Pultruded F/GRP products for the oil & gas,
power, cooling tower & petrochemical segments. Our trademarked brand consists of the INTECH Cable
support system INTECH structure profiles as well as customized products specialized for industrial
or infrastructure solutions, boasts an unparalleled track record across different countries &
industry applications.

[ Read more ][39]

## Our Products

With more than 20 years' experience in the FRP industry, INTECH is now one of the most prominent
globally-recognized composite brand.

Our product includes the trademarked INTECH cable support system. INTECH Structural profiles ,
gratings , caged ladder system and other customized solutions.

## Structural Profile

With more than 100 different profile types from I beam, hollow sections, C channels and other
complex shapes catering to the evolving cooling tower market segment where corrosion and light
weight takes precedence over traditional building material such as Steel & Concrete. All our
products are tested in accordance to the highest qualification of CTI-137 standards

[ Learn more ][40]

## Grating

INTECH grating products are widely used across industries such as offshore, onshore oil & gas.
Tackling weight constraints imposed on offshore platform users, generating overall project savings
through total weight optimization. Our products are 3rd party tested and approved under the ABS
(american bureau of shipping) product type approval class 1

[ Learn more ][41]

## Cable Ladder & Tray

standards. The complete system is designed to be anti-corrosive , fire retardant and non conductive.
servicing the growing market segment within oil & gas, power generation, water treatment and
renewable energy industry, where corrosion is a real-life problem for most of these clients.

applications. Engineered from high-strength, corrosion-resistant fiberglass composite materials, it
offers numerous advantages over traditional materials such as steel, aluminum, and wood. These
systems are ideally suited for environments where durability, safety, and minimal maintenance are
critical.

product are fit for application

[ Learn more ][44]

## Our Manufacturing Capabilities

capacity of up to 300km or 400 metric tons of pultruded profiles per month enabling us to support
Mega scale projects

A separate plant dedicated for efficient secondary fabrication process is equipped with high-tech
machineries such as Kuka robotic arm & CNC waterjet to cater for complex cut, drill & mill dimension
project requirements.

From custom structure designs to finding out the best material composition, project requirements can
be supported by our in-house engineering and design team. Our continuous product improvements and
R&D reflects our dedication and support towards providing clients with the best product and solution
available for your projects.

Fibreglass is a sustainable material that offers significant environmental advantages compared to
traditional materials like steel. Its’ lightweight, durability, and resistance to environmental
degradation promising a longer- lifespan. Its’ manufacturing process is energy-efficient, with much
lower carbon emission than steel. contributing to reduced carbon footprint. Ongoing innovations in
production and recycling are enhancing its sustainability, making FRP an increasingly viable choice
for various applications and supporting efforts to reduce environmental impact.

# Who we are ?

KPAC is a leading provider of advanced composite tooling solutions, Machines, Tools, Molds ,
dedicated to empowering industries with innovative and high-performance tooling technologies. With a
strong focus on precision, quality, and customer satisfaction, we deliver tailored solutions that
meet the unique requirements of diverse applications

Headquartered in Georgia, kpac has multiple office locations and we aim to serve local, regional and
national client base consisting of Fortune 500 and middle market companies. kpac extends the above
solutions and services to a broad spectrum of industry verticals ranging from automotive, insurance,
technology, financial, transportation, government and so on.
