# Who we are

[ View our Certification ][15]

Lawruk Machine and Tool has been a trusted precision manufacturer in central Pennsylvania since
1966. We serve a diverse range of industries from a state-of-the-art facility equipped with
multi-axis CNC machining, robotic automation, and advanced coordinate measuring capabilities that
ensure every part meets exact specification. As an ISO 9001:2015 certified operation, our commitment
to quality is built into every process — from the first cut to final dimensional verification.

## What we do

At **Lawruk Machine and Tool**, we offer a comprehensive range of machining services, including
vertical and horizontal milling, lathe work, pultrusion, surface grinding, and advanced 5-axis
machining. Our robotic machine tending capabilities deliver consistent, repeatable part handling
across production runs, complemented by in-house CMM dimensional verification to ensure every part
meets exact specification. We specialize in producing large-format, high-tolerance parts with
precision and consistency, whether in small batches or high-volume production runs. Our capabilities
support a wide range of industries, including Fortune 500 companies, defense contractors, mining,
and aerospace. From custom metal fabrication to complex component manufacturing, we deliver parts
built to your exact specifications. Explore our diverse fleet of machines to see how we can support
your next project. Check out our machine list.

## Just a few of our customers:

[Caterpillar Inc.]
[Komatsu]
[Rockland Manufacturing]
[Concurrent Technologies Corporation]
[The Equipment Lock Company]
[SMS Group]
[Bedford Reinforced Plastics]

## Our Mission

At **Lawruk Machine & Tool**, we take pride in delivering high-quality parts—on time and to exact
specifications. As an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** company, we adhere to some of the most rigorous
quality control standards in the industry, and we work to not only meet but exceed them on every
project. Our in-house **Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM)** and dedicated **Quality Assurance
(QA)** team ensure precise inspections, including 100% piece-part verification when required. We
apply these same high standards to our equipment, continuously investing in cutting-edge technology
to maintain the highest level of performance and quality. For us, precision isn’t just a goal—it’s a
commitment.

[ Learn More ][16]

Submit your quote request directly through our website using the link below. We provide fast,
reliable turnaround on all quote submissions. Once you receive your quote, you can conveniently
place your order using the link included in the quote form.

# Who we are

[ View our Certification ][15]

Lawruk Machine and Tool has been a trusted precision manufacturer in central Pennsylvania since
1966. We serve a diverse range of industries from a state-of-the-art facility equipped with
multi-axis CNC machining, robotic automation, and advanced coordinate measuring capabilities that
ensure every part meets exact specification. As an ISO 9001:2015 certified operation, our commitment
to quality is built into every process — from the first cut to final dimensional verification.

## What we do

At **Lawruk Machine and Tool**, we offer a comprehensive range of machining services, including
vertical and horizontal milling, lathe work, pultrusion, surface grinding, and advanced 5-axis
machining. Our robotic machine tending capabilities deliver consistent, repeatable part handling
across production runs, complemented by in-house CMM dimensional verification to ensure every part
meets exact specification. We specialize in producing large-format, high-tolerance parts with
precision and consistency, whether in small batches or high-volume production runs. Our capabilities
support a wide range of industries, including Fortune 500 companies, defense contractors, mining,
and aerospace. From custom metal fabrication to complex component manufacturing, we deliver parts
built to your exact specifications. Explore our diverse fleet of machines to see how we can support
your next project. Check out our machine list.

## Just a few of our customers:

[Caterpillar Inc.]
[Komatsu]
[Rockland Manufacturing]
[Concurrent Technologies Corporation]
[The Equipment Lock Company]
[SMS Group]
[Bedford Reinforced Plastics]

## Our Mission

At **Lawruk Machine & Tool**, we take pride in delivering high-quality parts—on time and to exact
specifications. As an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** company, we adhere to some of the most rigorous
quality control standards in the industry, and we work to not only meet but exceed them on every
project. Our in-house **Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM)** and dedicated **Quality Assurance
(QA)** team ensure precise inspections, including 100% piece-part verification when required. We
apply these same high standards to our equipment, continuously investing in cutting-edge technology
to maintain the highest level of performance and quality. For us, precision isn’t just a goal—it’s a
commitment.

#### [**Polyurethane Pultrusions**][56]

We manufacturer custom pultrusions using polyurethane resin technology. The advantages of
polyurethane resins include increased strength, increased stiffness, and excellent corrosion
resistance. Find out every benefit of our polyurethane pultrusion solutions!  

[[Pultruded Grating - Liberty Pultrusions]][57]

#### [**Pultruded Grating**][58]

UltraGrate® Pultruded Fiberglass Grating (UPFG) offers strength, rigidity, and high load capacity. 
UltraGrate pultruded fiberglass grating has a very high percentage of fiberglass in the composite
matrix. Liberty Pultrusions offered pultruded grating as a lightweight, low-maintenance solution.   

[[FRP baffle wall Fiberglass Fabrication by Liberty Pultrusions.]][59]

#### [**Fiberglass Fabrication**][60]

We can assist in the engineering, design, and fabrication of your finished structural fiberglass
system. When corrosion, electrical conductivity, RF transparency or weight, present a problem,
structural fiberglass provides the answer. Structural fiberglass is a very cost effective solution
when traditional materials cannot meet the demanding challenges of your application. 

[[Molded Grating]][61]

#### **[Molded Grating][62]**

UltraGrate Molded Fiberglass Grating is a hand lay-up composite of resin and continuous glass fiber
strand that is thoroughly wetted out and woven through an open mold. Our UltraGrate FRP Molded
Grating is an excellent alternative to metal grating where rust, corrosion, or chemical attacks are
problems.

#### **[Fiberglass Electrical Shapes][63]**

Fiberglass Electrical Shapes have outstanding electrical properties and are designed to support and
electrically isolate components in power control and distribution equipment.  Reinforced
with fiberglass, they are strong, stiff and stable.

### **The Liberty Pultrusions Process**

The pultrusion process allows us to provide high-quality products that are superior and longer
lasting than other types of materials such as steel, aluminum or timber. FRP Pultrusions are
corrosion resistant, non-conductive to electricity and heat and very light weight. Please read the
[Benefits of FRP Pultrusion Over Other Materials][64] page for more information. Please give us a
call with questions or request a quote if you are looking to purchase our premium pultrusion
products. We look forward to hearing from you!

Case Study

### Delivering savings and reliability through carbon fiber expertise

Our predictive mapping technologies and rigorous testing processes informed the final re-design of
commercial vehicle brackets with carbon fiber composites in place of steel. Our KyronMAX™ materials’
unique mechanical properties and new mold filling design created a more sustainable, reliable,
lightweight alternative.

**Developing new materials suitable for high-tech, high-spec applications**

specifications while actively beta testing its performance in real world applications. Our enhanced
polyamide-imide provides longer-lasting protection against oxygen cleaning erosion than typical
polyimides (PI).

[ Learn more ][16]

new type of liner assembled via interlocking segments and pre-inserted fastening elements, helping
the customer overcome this challenge and stay competitive.

## ONE-STOP
## COMPOSITE SOLUTIONS

## PRODUCTS

## Pultrusion

Our composite pultrusion system is designed for the manufacture of fiberglass reinforced pultrusion
products, and is applied to design in a way which is demanded its special application, including
customized shapes and standard structural pultruded fiberglass shapes, such as I beams, H beams,
angle profiles, and rods.

Our composite pultrusion system consists of a polyester pultrusion system and a polyurethane
pultrusion system.

## BMC and SMC

Our composite Bulk Molding Compounds (BMCs) and Sheet Molding Compounds (SMCs) provide solutions for
the diversification of composite shapes.

Our composite BMCs & SMCs use a semi-dry method for manufacturing thermoset fiberglass reinforced
products. With the hot-press molding process, the pre-formed molding compounds of all necessary
ingredients are formed to the custom

## Prepreg and Laminate

Our composite prepreg is the B-stage (semi-cured) and C-stage (full-cured) epoxy resin coating on
both sides of the DMD and SHS. A substrate coated with the resin will strengthen all aspects of
performance, including those related to temperature, electrical, and mechanical properties.

 

Our composite products are composed of multi-layer flexible insulation materials (such as Nomex®,
Aramid Paper, non-woven, PET film, and polyimide film) with a heat-resistant adhesive bonding.

## SERVICE

[PicService1]

### Product Design

Together with our customers, we create products based on our 14 years of know-how and experience.
Throughout these years, we have been applying our know-how experience to provide solutions for
customers in the wind turbine, energy, and infrastructure industries.
[PicService2]

### Proofing & Testing

Together with engineering company and testing agencies, our company can provide a variety of
services including product property calculation, product 3D modeling, product proofing, third-party
product testing.
[PicService3]

### Delivery

Covering all modes of transport, based on your business needs, our company can suggest the most
effective and efficient shipment options available. At the heart of our service is our commitment to
customer service and quality.

The entire product supply process will be transparent and each step will be traceable.

## ABOUT US

Established in 2015, Mingfeng Composite Europe B.V. is a forward-looking company focused mainly on
providing products and non-stop solutions for our customers’ composite needs.

In 2017, our company successfully developed composite products for wind turbine electrical
insulation, resulting in an alternative to costly epoxy laminate products.

Since then, we have continued to expand the application of composites, to the aerospace,
architecture, automotive, energy, infrastructure, marine, military, and sports and recreation
sectors.

Our company’s team is constantly acquiring knowledge about new composite materials and applying this
knowledge in practice.

## CONTACT

#### Inquiries

For any inquiries, questions or commendations, please call: +31 (0)6 39 214 758 or fill out the
following form

Your Name (required)

Your Email (required)

Subject

Your Message

#### Head Office

Rivium Boulevard 301-320
2909 LK, Capelle aan den IJssel
the Netherlands

 

Tel: +31 (0)6 39 214 758

Email: info@mingfeng.nl

#### Employment

To apply for a job with Mingfeng Composite Europe B.V. Please send a cover letter together with your
C.V. to: info@mingfeng.nl

Our composite BMCs & SMCs use a semi-dry method for manufacturing thermoset fiberglass reinforced
products. With the hot-press molding process, the pre-formed molding compounds of all necessary
ingredients are formed to the custom

## Prepreg and Laminate

Our composite prepreg is the B-stage (semi-cured) and C-stage (full-cured) epoxy resin coating on
both sides of the DMD and SHS. A substrate coated with the resin will strengthen all aspects of
performance, including those related to temperature, electrical, and mechanical properties.

 

Our composite products are composed of multi-layer flexible insulation materials (such as Nomex®,
Aramid Paper, non-woven, PET film, and polyimide film) with a heat-resistant adhesive bonding.

## SERVICE

[PicService1]

### Product Design

Together with our customers, we create products based on our 14 years of know-how and experience.
Throughout these years, we have been applying our know-how experience to provide solutions for
customers in the wind turbine, energy, and infrastructure industries.
[PicService2]

### Proofing & Testing

Together with engineering company and testing agencies, our company can provide a variety of
services including product property calculation, product 3D modeling, product proofing, third-party
product testing.
[PicService3]

### Delivery

Covering all modes of transport, based on your business needs, our company can suggest the most
effective and efficient shipment options available. At the heart of our service is our commitment to
customer service and quality.

The entire product supply process will be transparent and each step will be traceable.

## ABOUT US

Established in 2015, Mingfeng Composite Europe B.V. is a forward-looking company focused mainly on
providing products and non-stop solutions for our customers’ composite needs.

In 2017, our company successfully developed composite products for wind turbine electrical
insulation, resulting in an alternative to costly epoxy laminate products.

Since then, we have continued to expand the application of composites, to the aerospace,
architecture, automotive, energy, infrastructure, marine, military, and sports and recreation
sectors.

Our company’s team is constantly acquiring knowledge about new composite materials and applying this
knowledge in practice.

recreation, and automotive manufacturing.

### Adhesive Systems

Injection systems for closed mould processes, two-component adhesive dispensing in multiple mix
ratios, cartridge filling, and composite putty application.

Hand-held spray guns for gelcoat and chop applications. Air trigger models reduce operator fatigue

Distillation units that recover and recycle solvent waste from composite production, reducing
disposal costs and workplace exposure. Material fluid heaters maintain correct viscosity for
consistent application.

A comprehensive range of mould release chemistry: conventional solvent-based systems, semi-permanent

## Frequently Asked

### What composite equipment does MVP UK & Ireland supply?

MVP UK & Ireland supplies composite spray equipment including chopper and wet-out systems, gelcoat
spray systems, injection systems, adhesive dispensing systems, cartridge filling stations, putty
systems and a range of hand-held spray guns and applicators. We also supply solvent recovery and
recycling units and material fluid heaters.

### What are water-based release agents for composite moulds?

Water-based mould release agents are solvent-free alternatives to conventional release chemistry.
They eliminate VOC emissions from the release agent application step and are suitable for
manufacturers seeking to reduce workplace solvent exposure or meet current environmental
regulations. MVP UK & Ireland supplies water-based release agents alongside guidance on
transitioning from solvent-based systems.

### What is a semi-permanent mould release agent?

A semi-permanent release agent is applied to a composite mould and provides multiple releases before
reapplication is needed. This reduces application frequency compared to conventional wax systems,
lowering product consumption and the total volume of release agent used per production run. MVP UK &
Ireland supplies semi-permanent systems alongside conventional alternatives, with advice on which is
appropriate for a given process.

### Does MVP UK supply mould release agents for composites?

Yes. MVP UK & Ireland supplies a full range of mould release chemistry for composite tooling,
including conventional solvent-based release agents, semi-permanent systems, water-based release
agents, mould sealers, mould prep primers and mould cleaners. Our team can advise on the correct
product for a given resin system, mould material and production rate.

### Does MVP UK supply solvent recovery equipment?

Yes. MVP UK & Ireland supplies solvent recovery and recycling units for composite manufacturing.
These distillation units recover solvent from production waste, reducing disposal costs and limiting
workplace solvent exposure. Units are available in different capacities to suit varying production
volumes.

### Does MVP UK provide on-site technical support?

Yes. MVP UK & Ireland has technically experienced personnel available and can provide upon request
on-site equipment commissioning, operator training, process troubleshooting and ongoing support.

## Company Overview

Founded in 1999, Nanjing Haoli Hydraulic Equipment Co., Ltd is a manufacturing enterprise by science
and technology. We are mainly engaged in developing, designing and manufacturing hydraulic pump
stations, hydraulic transmission and control systems, and centralized lubrication systems. Our
company entered the field of composite materials in the year of 2000. We are the earliest one in
China to help many domestic research institutes in related fields to digest and absorb FRP
pultrusion technology introduced overseas and then provide self-produced pultruders, as well as
offered assistance to many enterprises to carry on many technology transfer programs. Nanjing Haoli
Hydraulic Equipment Co., Ltd has won a good reputation for manufacturing high quality and durable
pultrusion machines in the domestic market. More than 400 pultrusion lines' experience has given us
plentiful experience in machinery building. This fact shows a high reliability of our company in
pultrusion industry in China and great capability of developing domestic pultrusion techniques. Our
company has 40 employees and 6 technical engineers with excellent experience. Our factory attained
ISO certification in 2007. Nanjing Haoli Hydraulic Equipment Co., Ltd is a member of
China-Fiber-Glass Association. Now Haoli's products are covering full FRP production and centralized
lubrication system. 1. Pultrusion equipment and ancillary equipment, such as 7 types of standard
pultrusion machines, creels, slitters, cutters, and resin mixers 2. Pull winding pipes/tubes 3. FRP
mold fabrication 4. GFRP Rebar and forming equipment 5. Complex pultruded profiles, epoxy profiles
and cooling tower's blades. 6. Haoli's lubrication pumps cover many industries, such as machine
tools, textiles, elevators, plastic, printing, food processing, packing, steel mills, cranes,
mining, vehicles, and glass. "Integrity and customers always come first" is our permanent commitment
to customers. We attach more importance to considerate services apart from marketing. Haoli will
provide all customers with pre-sales consulting and relevant industrial information in a bid to
create a greater profit for you. Haoli will work in partnership with old and new customers sincerely
to create a bright future together.

# For Every Industry.

## Pultrusion Technology
## For Every Industry.

We work with you to create complete custom solutions for pultrusion. Machines, dies, process tech,
or consulting — we’re the experts you’re looking for!

[LET’S GET STARTED][9]

## Our Services

[Pultrusion Equipment]

### MACHINES

PulFORCE offers a full range of state-of-the-art [pultrusion machines][10], including standard
models as well as fully custom designs. We also supply all the necessary corollary equipment for a
turnkey operation.

[Pultrusion Tooling]

### TOOLING

Our capabilities include design and production of complete tooling systems including dies, in-feed,
forming, injection, and wet-out systems.

[Pultrusion Technology]

### TECHNOLOGY

Our experience allows us to offer [pultrusion technologies][11] for a vast array of industries. From
thin-wall complex profiles to heavy-wall structural shapes, polyurethane, epoxy, UV and more.

[Pultrusion Technology Transfer]

### TRANSFER

Our proven system includes on-site development and training. We have successfully transferred
complex, turnkey systems all around the world.

## State-of-the-Art Pultrusion Machines
## & Processing Technology

We design, engineer, build & transfer turnkey pultrusion systems. Our team has extensive processing
experience across a vast array of technologies and industry – we know the entire pultrusion process
inside and out, not just building the equipment.

### Our Turnkey Solutions Include:

### TECHNOLOGY

The first step for any successful pultrusion system is choosing and implementing the right
[technology][12]. Resins, reinforcements and the processing technology that brings them together
affects the design of equipment and tooling.

### MACHINES

Our tried-and-true standard [pultrusion machines][13], or a custom machine built to enhance your
specific processing technology. We make sure the machine works for you!

### TOOLING

Designed and produced to work in concert with the entire process. Quality tooling is a must for
successful systems.

### DEVELOPMENT

Fine-tuning the system for optimum performance. We can help debug your system, define process
parameters and set the stage for continuous
improvement.

### TRAINING & TRANSFER

People are your #1 asset. We can help them understand your system and develop the skills necessary
for success.

En matériaux composites, que ce soit pour des besoins spécifiques en profilés de pultrusion ou
pour trouver une solution durable pour remplacer d’autres matériaux (bois, métal, etc).

Pultrall est une entreprise solide, impliquée dans sa communauté depuis 1987, en plus d’être un
acteur économique important à Thetford Mines. La pultrusion, est un procédé de fabrication encore
plutôt méconnu est au cœur des activités de Pultrall. Il s’agit d’un procédé de fabrication en
continu de profilés d’un plastique renforcé, selon lequel une grande résistance unidirectionnelle
est obtenue par traction de fils de base continus, imprégnés de résine, à travers une filière
chauffante.

# Leading the way in Composite Technology.

## Contact the Composites Experts

Market Leaders in Composite Technology for over 40 years

[ Contact Us Here ][34]

or call [+44 (0) 1206 395 559][35]

[ [A wide range of composite products] ][36]

Pultrex ISO Accredited Profiles Division produce an [**extensive range of pultruded & pullwound
profiles** ][37]for UK & European customers, and **provide the support you need** to find the right
products for your application. With 5 pultrusion lines operating 24 hours a day, 6 days a week,
**Pultrex is capable of producing high volumes** of products to suit a vast range of applications –
from DIY tools, Ladders and Walkways, to Civil Engineering, Railways, and Building Industries. You
can view the available dimensions and typical applications of various tubes, rods, bars and sections
in the pultruded products guide below.

[Composite machinery inside a warehouse][Composite machinery inside a warehouse]
[ Pultrusion Machinery ][38] [ Filament Winding Machines ][39]

Pultrex is a global supplier of **high quality, efficient, and reliable** Pultrusion, Pull Winding &
Filament Winding Machines to the automotive, aerospace, defence, and civil and construction
industries. **In-house support is also available for companies developing their own** composite
manufacturing cells. Thermoplastic and Thermoset Pultrusion machines are available in seven sizes,
and the modular construction of Filament Winding Machines ensures solutions can be tailored to meet
specific requirements. All composite machinery has a well-proven production track record for
reliability and performance.

# Fiberglass Pultruded Building Materials

Fiberglass pultruded building materials outperform traditional options like wood, steel, and
aluminum. They are stronger, lighter, and offer superior resistance to weathering and corrosion, all
while maintaining low thermal conductivity.

[ Contact Us ][1]

#### Handrail

Our pultruded handrails use reinforced polymers (FRP) and are engineered to provide exceptional
strength and durability.

#### Decks

Our pultruded decks meet the highest standards of quality and performance, providing long-lasting
value and peace of mind.

#### Stairs

Ideal for both industrial and commercial applications where strength, longevity, and corrosion
resistance are critical.

## Structural Pultrusions

Structural pultrusions are advanced composite materials that provide a unique combination of
strength, durability, and flexibility. Created through the pultrusion process—where reinforced
fibers, such as fiberglass, are saturated with resin and pulled through a heated die—these profiles
deliver unmatched performance in a wide range of applications.

[ More About Us ][2]

## Best in Class Manufacturing, Engineering, and Installation

Pultrudex delivers fully integrated turnkey solutions that guide your project through every stage —
from initial concept and engineering design to manufacturing, structural fabrication, and final
installation. Our process leverages advanced composite engineering, pultrusion, molding, filament
winding, and continuous lamination technologies, all backed by decades of R&D and technical
expertise. This end-to-end service ensures precision and reliability, whether you’re designing
custom platforms, stairs, rail systems, or other FRP infrastructure.

## Trusted Engineering & Installation Services

We are more than just a product supplier — we are the full-service partner for your project. As the
**manufacturer** of the Pultrudex product line, the **assembler** of complete systems, and the
**on-site installer** of our products and assemblies, we ensure quality and consistency at every
stage. From concept to installation, Pultrudex delivers turnkey solutions built to last.

## Request a quote or information

### Thank you for your interest in our products, we always welcome your questions and comments about
### our company.

### About Ashirvad Industries

Ashirvad Industries offers machinery and equipment’s for composites industry-mainly pultrusion
machine, pultrusion dies & sheet moulding compound machine.

Pultrusion machinery are used for producing pultruded profiles, GRP (glass reinforced plastic) and
FRP (fiberglass reinforced plastic) Sections in different shapes and sizes like angle sections, ‘C’
channels, hollow rectangular and circular-tube sections, solid rods, etc.,

Our pultrusion machines are CE certified (with CE marking) as per EU standards for health, safety,
and environmental protection.

Having customer base in many composite industry of India and export market, We export composite
pultrusion machine, pultrusion equipment, pultrusion line & pultrusion, pultrusion accessories, smc
machine in USA, UK, Italy, Russia, Ireland, Canada, Argentina, Mexico, Brazil, Indonesia, UAE, Saudi
Arabia, Qatar, Turkey, Egypt, Ukraine, Nigeria, Nepal, Australia, Spain, Malaysia, South Africa, and
in many other European countries.

Dedicated to composites industries by 100% of our production used in composite projects, Involving,
PULTRUSION and SMC Process.

Involved in continuous support to composite industry, by adopting enhance automation, with efficient
processing, inspection and quality control methods.

The company works with the motto of providing excellence and state of the art technology to the
composites industry.

### NPI Video ADO: High Performance DC Fuse

The new SCHURTER ADO series is a fuse with a rated current range of 10 to 63 A and a maximum
operating current of 40 A at 1000 VDC. It is designed for applications in direct current systems up
to 1000 VDC and is suitable for use in electric vehicles.

The demand for fast and reliable energy storage is increasing in our connected, all-electric world.
SCHURTER’s prismatic supercapacitors are the world’s thinnest supercaps, offering the perfect
solution for rapid energy storage and release.

rechargeable batteries and capacitors. They can store enormous amounts of energy and release it very

touch panel. And this only in 7 steps!

industrial, medical and energy applications. From compact DIN-rail solutions and high-performance
3-phase filters to robust DC filters for PV and storage systems – our products ensure excellent
attenuation, safety and compliance with global standards. Whether for compact devices or
high-current systems, SCHURTER filters offer reliable EMI suppression, high quality and easy
integration.

testing and qualification as well as in various services. This makes SCHURTER an independent,
reliable partner for our customers.

[Discover our Competences][117]

## Statement by the SCHURTER Group on Supply Chain Resilience

At SCHURTER, we operate as a globally active company with production facilities strategically
located across multiple regions. We continuously invest in these facilities to ensure they are
equipped with the latest technologies, enabling us to operate efficient, internationally connected
production sites.

Being a reliable partner to our customers is at the heart of everything we do. That is why we have
built robust and resilient supply chains—both in collaboration with our suppliers and within our
globally interconnected production network. These supply chains are regularly exposed to simulated
stress tests, allowing us to proactively identify and prevent potential vulnerabilities.

Even In the case of geopolitical shifts, we at SCHURTER are well-prepared to maintain our high level
of delivery reliability. Our customers can rely on us to remain a consistent and dependable
partner—even in uncertain times.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

# SERRALLERIA RCM

Su empresa de cerrajería en Reus
Serralleria RCM estamos especializados en todo tipo de trabajos de **cerrajería metálica** y
**estructuras metálicas**, ya se su su fabricación, montaje o reparación de cualquier estructura
metálica de acero inoxidable o hierro. Por otro lado, disponemos de una experiencia de más de **15
años fabricando cerrajería y cerramientos** tanto en el ámbito industrias, como para el ámbito
privado y en obra nueva. En estos últimos años hemos incorporado a nuestros servicios la parte de
**cerrajería de pultrusión**, siendo una de las empresas pioneras en la provincia de Tarragona en
fabricación de elementos de pultrusión para la industria. Realizamos todo tipo de **mantenimiento
industrial** en Tarragona para todo tipo de empresas
[maquinaria-cerrajeria]

### Innovación

Para nosotros la innovación es un pilar fundamental en RCM por ello, cada año invertimos en nueva
maquinaria y formación para ofrecer una fabricación de mayor calidad.

[null]

### Experiencia

Nuestros 15 años en el sector y nuestros clientes nos avalan como una de las empresas mas
importantes de en trabajos metálicos en la provincia de Tarragona.

[prevencion-de-riesgos]

### Prevención

En Serralleria RCM cumplimos siempre las normativas de prevención de riesgos y dotamos a nuestro
equipo de trabajo con todos los EPIS necesarios.

## SERVICIOS DE CERRAJERÍA

En **Serralleria RCM** ofrecemos todo tipo de servicios relacionados con la cerrajería ya sea

# Complex multiphysics phenomena

The pultrusion process is conceptually quite simple. However, the analysis of its physics, dynamics
and definition of optimal processing parameters, are complex tasks.

There is a multiphysics phenomenon and a large number of variables involved in the pultrusion
process. As a consequence, satisfactory experimental analysis for manufacturing purposes requires
considerable time which is obviously not a cost-efficient approach.

Therefore, developing suitable computational models is crucial to analyse the process considering
different composite manufacturing aspects. These are heat transfer, curing kinetics, polymerization
phase transformations, resin flow and solid mechanics.

The expensive trial-and-error approaches for designing new products and optimising process
conditions can be avoided using PultruSim software.

## Advanced technology in material development

Spilka Composites specialize in both pultrusion and filament-winding technology.

[Read more][24]

## Reliable performance in extreme conditions

We create tailor-made composite components that withstands challenging environments characterized by
high corrosion rates and large mechanical forces.

Composites offer distinct advantages in many use cases compared to more conventional materials like
steel, aluminum, wood, or concrete.

[Stories][25]
[Rough sea]
[A stack of white composite thresholds.]

## A modern material with a perfect mix of quality and sustainability

Our composite materials is a great fit for applications where customizability, longevity, and
sustainability matters.

[Sustainability][26]

## Stories

[
[Scanmudring pressure housing upgrade]

### Scanmudring pressure housing upgrade

Scanmudring, a leader in subsea excavation and dredging services, approached us with a request to
upgrade their 20Te excavator’s subsea pressure housing for use at greater depths. After several
years of use, the housings needed to be verified for use at a depth of 3000 meters.

][27]
[
[Enduring product design: GRP Cabinets for Bane NOR]

### Enduring product design: GRP Cabinets for Bane NOR

In 1988, a groundbreaking development project began between Norges Statsbaner (now known as Bane
NOR) and Spilka Composites. This collaboration resulted in what we now know as GRP cabinets from
Spilka Composites. More than 30 years later, these cabinets remain a standard along Norwegian
railways, a testament to excellent and enduring product design.

][28]
[
[Fiberglass radomes for protecting advanced antennas]

### Fiberglass radomes for protecting advanced antennas

Normarc Instrument Landing Systems by Indra have been an industry benchmark for more than 20 years.
Well over 200,000,000 safe landings have been carried out with help from Normarc ILS at nearly 1400
airports worldwide.

][29]

## Experience + knowledge

### Pioneering for sustainability

### Cross-industry experience

### Tailor-made solutions for a global market

### 30 years of innovation and manufacturing

Embrace the future of innovation with us. As a leading manufacturer of composite products, we are
committed to helping you design and develop the next generation of sustainable advancements.

Partner with us to create advanced, durable, and environmentally friendly composite products that
meet the highest standards. Start your journey towards creating innovative, sustainable solutions
today.

[Get in touch][30]
[Two men, one blurry in the front, the other smiling looking at the camera.]

## We're here to help

Get in touch and let us find the perfect composite solution for your project.

Because installation of Strongwell FRP is much simpler than steel, structures built using
Strongwell’s pultruded products can cost as much as 15% less than carbon steel, 30% less than

specialized labor. Avoid costly specialized labor and heavy equipment, and speed the construction
process by using Strongwell pultruded structural products.

electrical and thermal conductor, and offers high dielectric capabilities.
MAINTENANCE FREE
Strongwell FRP is durable and impact resistant. It will not dent or deform like metals. Resists rot
and corrosion, eliminating the need for constant maintenance. This combination of performance and
durability offers the ideal solution in numerous applications.
